sourceTitle: An Elegy Wrote in a Country Church Yard (1751) and The Eton College Manuscript
description: "An Elegy Wrote in a Country Church Yard" by Thomas Gray is a poem completed in 1750 and first published in 1751. Written after personal losses, including the death of Gray's aunt, the poem meditates on death and remembrance.
